L29 f0022/f0029 board writes Vy=-q*y/(2pi*r²), repeated in captions612-633s. Its phi=Ux+q*ln(r)/(2pi) and psi=Uy+q*theta/(2pi) require positive Vy. Chapter corrects by both derivative routes, continuity and boundary check.
L28 f0117 vortex phi appears as Gamma/(2pi theta), unlike correct L29 recap f0011 Gamma*theta/(2pi). Chapter uses the derivative-consistent multiplier; theta belongs outside denominator.
L29 shifted-source f0058/f0061 second logarithm has handwritten -2ar*cos(theta) where geometry requires -2(a/r)*cos(theta). Chapter derives dimensionless expression directly from r1².

L29 captions2319-2323 say pure-doublet streamlines deviate from circles farther out. Equation psi=-m*sin(theta)/r proves every nonzero level is exactly a circle minus the origin; chapter corrects this and distinguishes other superpositions.
Source singular divergence and vortex curl are undefined at origin, not a small nonzero region: chapter avoids the spoken0/r blow-up interpretation and qualifies circulation versus local curl.
L28 uniform-flow atmospheric pressure is a possible reference choice, not a consequence of constant speed; chapter states pressure is spatially constant with separately supplied value.

L29 final opposite-vortex construction is stated in last captions2401-2423.56s; last fullframes f0080/f0081 retain earlier doublet board and speaker, not a fully worked vortex-pair diagram. Orientation and moment derivation are explicitly original teaching construction.
